title: Refactor PHP to TypeScript
problem_statement: Legacy PHP scripts need to be modernized to TypeScript for better maintainability and performance.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology leading to increased maintenance costs and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Convert PHP scripts to TypeScript, ensuring all functionalities are preserved and tested.
success_criteria: All legacy functionalities are available in TypeScript.
No regression in performance or security.

provenance.evidence: Legacy PHP script identified for refactoring.
